newsitem.title: USA: IKON president Dinkelacker to add CFO title.
newsitem.headline: IKON president Dinkelacker to add CFO title.

text.p: IKON Office Solution Inc said Monday that its president Kurt Dinkelacker, was named to the additional post of chief financial officer, a position he previously held.
Dinkelacker will manage the company's transformation activities, the company said.

IKON said that under the transformation program it will consolidate purchasing, inventory control, logistics, and other activities into 13 customer service centers in the U.S., establish a single financial processing center, use a common information technology system, adopt a common name, and create field operations with greater attention to customer sales and service.
The company also said that John Stuart, chairman and chief executive officer, will assume direct responsibility for field operations.

Robert Kearns, currently senior vice president and chief financial officer becomes senior vice president, finance, responsible for managing the financial and accounting changes affecting the newly-created customer service centers.
IKON said it expects to complete the transformation program, which began last year, in October 1998.

IKON provides customers with total office solutions from copier and printing systems, computer networking and overflow duplicating services to copy center management, technology training and electronic file conversion.
The company had fiscal 1996 revenues of $4 billion.
